title: A new chapter
bodyMd:
The room is the same one Walter Brewing built. The bar runs down the same wall, the taps are ten, heavy on German imports, and the burger is still ground behind the bar and charbroiled while you watch.

Fridays start at eleven with hand-breaded cod and end when it is gone. Wednesdays are wings. Tuesdays are still the peanut butter burger. Happy hour is Monday through Friday, four to six, and the root beer that saw the place through Prohibition is still on tap, in a frosted mug, for the kids and for anyone who remembers.

The back booths hold birthdays, Packer parties and the work crew on a Thursday night. The board above the bar says whether the kitchen is open, what is pouring and what game is on, and it says the same thing on this website, live, so you never drive over to a dark door.

A hundred and forty-five years in, the sign out front is new and the corner is not. Come sit in it.

You're a stranger here but once.
